title: Nothing Great Is Made Alone / collaborative typesetting

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is midpoint poster

slide_intent: Let the act of rearranging words explain a teamwork claim because seeing the contribution can make the promise concrete.
strategic_value: Multiple cursors building the campaign line can connect Figma’s brand story directly to its shared editing model.
demonstration: Colored cursors select and rearrange black words into the campaign sentence, followed by wordmark selection and assembly of the colored symbol.
practical_value: Use sequential typesetting to make the meaning of a campaign line emerge through collaboration.

content_islands.name: Word sequence
content_islands.spec: Begin with ALONE and progressively add and reposition the other words on white.

content_islands.name: Editing cues
content_islands.spec: Retain selection boxes and several colored cursors while the sentence is assembled.

content_islands.name: Signature
content_islands.spec: Finish with the wordmark and collaborative symbol reveal.

reference_purposes.Intent: The case-study narrative says the campaign challenges the lone-genius story and invites wider teams to participate.
reference_purposes.Expression: Several visible cursors transform the word arrangement and build the final identity.
